svg.text: Read the traced shape at its display size
Open this sheet at 100% for the labeled pixel sizes. Every sample uses the same unchanged vector path.
32 / 48 px expose detail loss; they are diagnostic examples. At 64 px, inspect the silhouette before relying on small grip or sparkle details.
Use the larger examples to judge the selected contours. No world-sign minimum size or engine mip performance is established here.
